root_cause.text: The `arena_alloc_pages()` function in the BPF arena subsystem fails to validate the `node_id` parameter against valid NUMA node limits and online status before propagating it to memory allocation functions.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional check `if (node_id != NUMA_NO_NODE && ((unsigned int)node_id >= nr_node_ids || !node_online(node_id)))` in `kernel/bpf/arena.c`, directly addressing the CVE description which states the function previously forwarded `node_id` "through the entire allocation chain without any bounds checking."
